systems.system: Centralised digital road-safety platform for National Police data (unnamed)
systems.country_label: dispositif digital centralisé dédié à la gestion des données de la Police nationale
systems.owner: Ministry of Finance, responsible for the digital economy, with the Police nationale
systems.tiers: Being set up at 3 December 2025, pilot not yet launched; instant checks of licences, insurance, roadworthiness and vehicle status; a users' app to pay fines by mobile money and report road incidents; a geographic information system to follow patrols; interconnection of the Police, OTRACO, insurers, the revenue office, telecoms and the Police judiciaire

note: The platform is described by road-traffic functions only (licence, insurance and vehicle checks, fines, patrol tracking), which is the single-function class; the document does not say that stations record reports or cases in it, and names no commissariat or post.
